title: Clear data ownership paves the way for data-driven manufacturing
summary: Businesses across industries generate and use large amounts of data to make strategic insights-led decisions and improve their operations. Within manufacturing, data is produced at every stage of the production process—from design and prototyping to production and quality control. However, the question of who owns this data can be complex, and it's becoming increasingly important for businesses to understand their rights and responsibilities of data ownership.
